entities.name: Vram
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Dobéhma who could alter seasons and accidentally blew up the Foulmere Swamp, flinging her through the multiverse.

entities.name: Mao
entities.description: Vram's daughter, appearing as a cat under a shapeshifting spell.

entities.name: Peter Langwynd
entities.description: Naturalist under whose wing Mao was placed.

entities.name: Foulmere Swamp
entities.description: Swamp accidentally blown up by Vram.

events.summary: Vram puts her daughter Mao under the wing of the naturalist Peter Langwynd.
Vram is attacked by another planeswalker and accidentally blows up the Foulmere Swamp, flinging her through the multiverse and abandoning Mao.
events.quote: she was attacked by another planeswalker and accidentally blew up the Foulmere Swamp

relations.quote: who turned out to be her daughter under a shapeshifting spell
